messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Some medicines can cause unwanted or dangerous effects when used with simvastatin. Your doctor may need to change your treatment plan if you use certain antibiotics or antifungal medicines, heart medication, antiviral medications such as hepatitis C medications, HIV/AIDS medications, or Paxlovid for COVID-19.
Stop taking this medication and tell your doctor right away if you become pregnant.
Triplet: ["simvastatin", "has interaction warning", "antiviral medications"]

The relation 'has interaction warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication may cause unwanted or dangerous effects when used in combination with the specified medication or substance, and medical supervision or treatment adjustment may be required.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
